producer_screening_negative.e0000_search: Neither +0xE0000 (00 00 0E 00) nor sign-extended -0xE0000 (00 00 F2 FF) appears as an immediate in any executable section of any of the six binaries; the only raw dword hits sit inside OpenSSL AES_set_encrypt_key code and non-executable data/debug sections.
producer_screening_negative.conclusion: No Linux client code computes the Region A physical address; there is no Linux Region A pointer producer in this set.
producer_screening_negative.io_screening: checkdiskback has exactly one ReadSectorData call site and zero WriteSectorData call sites (read-only checker); EdpEDiskBack has no raw sector I/O at all (file-level backup daemon).
producer_screening_negative.runtime_log: edpedisk/edpedisk.log (2026-08-03) records two CoreService exceptions at Edpedisk::File::ReadCompleteBuffer:67; no Region A address evidence.

flow: Try EdpDiskSectorLayout::GetAvailableLayouts() V1 list; on success return via GetPartExtInfo.
On V1 failure try GetAvailableLayoutsV2() list, which includes EdpDiskLayoutOldTageIndex (the legacy LBA7 0x40-stride parser).
On V2 success call Edpedisk::GetPartionFromOld(new_entries, old_entries) at 0x4301e, converting all three 0x40 legacy entries field-by-field into 0x60 runtime entries.
Set runtime table version to 0x64 at Volume+0x10a4, identical to the Windows legacy EdpEDiskCtrl fallback (runtime version 0x64).
cross_platform_fallback_consumer_confirm.significance: The Windows-only finding of 2026-09-23 (legacy LBA7 fallback mounting a Region A extent) is now confirmed as a deliberate cross-platform product behavior implemented independently in the Linux client, still conditional on new-label read failure.
cross_platform_fallback_consumer_confirm.limit: This is static evidence of the same conditional path; no runtime proof that any sampled disk took the fallback on Linux either.

hypotheses: H1 ciphertext = SIMPLE(K0) then AES layer: decrypt AES(key8, counter=offset) then rolling XOR

stacked_layer_k0_bruteforce_negative.result: no structure found; the single BKDP candidate on lexar H2 quadratic at K0=0xf204 is rejected as coincidence because the decoded buffer remains high entropy with no surrounding structure
stacked_layer_k0_bruteforce_negative.untested: SIMPLE-then-AES encryption order (would need 65536 AES passes); SIMPLE keyed differently than K0-only

proves: The conditional legacy LBA7 fallback that can mount a Region A extent is a deliberate cross-platform design reproduced in the Linux client, including the 0x40-to-0x60 entry conversion and the 0x64 runtime version marker.
The EDP data-plane cipher semantics (EDPSECDISK AES-128, per-block counter equal to the virtual byte offset) are confirmed in a second independent implementation.
The Linux client contains no Region A address computation and no raw-disk writer that could be the Region A producer.
A SIMPLE rolling-XOR second layer over the AES-decrypted or raw Region A ciphertext is excluded for all 65536 K0 values under both known step variants on the two CRC-verified-key disks.
does_not_prove: That any sampled disk ever took the fallback on Linux or Windows.

The Region A plaintext format or its true producer; the remaining Linux leads are the old-profile header read path (where the header buffer is fetched) and the ydcc 2025 update chain, both unscreened.
That the cipher list for the old profile is exactly [EDPAES]; a differently keyed or ordered stack is not excluded.
